verdict.rationale: The evidence shows code examples that can be run, but no interactive API reference. The PHP SDK README includes Create/Read/Update/Delete examples, and the OAuth client README examples run against an isolated sandbox environment. No interactive explorer or API console is evidenced, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API reference or explorer, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, try-it-now runnable examples in the reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
